context: Tests whether a test-mode cleaning pass deletes tautological and vacuous tests, unmocks pure functions so the real code is exercised, collapses happy-path clones, and preserves or strengthens every real assertion.

checklist.name: Tautologies removed
checklist.description: The expect(total(items)).toBe(total(items)) self-comparison and the expect(total).toBeDefined() existence check are deleted or replaced with assertions against independent expected values

checklist.name: Mock replaced with real call
checklist.description: The applyDiscount test calls the real applyDiscount instead of asserting against a vi.fn() mock of it; applyDiscount ends up with genuine coverage (e.g. a real value and/or the out-of-range throw)

checklist.name: Happy-path clones collapsed
checklist.description: The one/two/three-item copies are consolidated into one test or a parameterized table rather than three near-identical bodies

checklist.name: Real coverage preserved
checklist.description: The negative-quantity throw assertion survives, and correct-total behavior is still asserted with independent expected numbers; no behavior loses its only coverage

checklist.name: No new test slop
checklist.description: The rewritten suite adds no snapshot-of-own-output tests, no mocks of pure code, and no comments narrating each assertion

checklist.name: Coverage gaps reported honestly
checklist.description: If any boundary is left untested (e.g. discount percent out of range, empty cart), the response either adds the test or names the gap instead of staying silent
